text: Open a project from a Git URL: shallow clone into a local cache, open it read-only
description: On the project selection screen, accept a Git URL (https or ssh, any host). The backend shallow-clones it (git clone --depth 1) into a per-user cache directory keyed by host/owner/repo, refreshes with a fetch on reopen, and opens the contained .bowman read-only. No API tokens, no GitHub-specific API. Handle: repo without .bowman (clear message), large repos (depth 1, no checkout of unrelated files if feasible), private repos (fails gracefully unless the user's own git credentials allow it).

status.comment:
Open from Git URL implemented and verified live with github.com/aimparency/v7; awaiting acceptance.

backend/src/git-repository-cache.ts openGitRepository(url): git clone --depth 1 --no-tags --filter=blob:none --sparse -- <url>, sparse-checkout set .bowman, into $AIMPARENCY_GIT_CACHE or $XDG_CACHE_HOME/aimparency/repos/<host>/<owner>/<repo>; reopen = fetch --depth 1 + reset --hard FETCH_HEAD (re-clone if origin differs); no .bowman -> clear error, clone removed; writes runtime/read-only. Safety: shared gitRepositoryLocation accepts only https/http/ssh/scp-style (file: test-only), rejects option-like segments; GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0, 120 s timeout. project.openGitUrl mutation; picker shows 'Open read-only' / 'Cloning…', skips folder inspection for URLs, errors as toast.

Evidence: git-repository-cache.test.ts (4: sparse read-only clone without src/, refresh picks up an upstream commit, no-.bowman reported + not kept, unreachable repo fails with git's reason, URL acceptance/refusal incl. ext::, file, -oProxyCommand); ProjectSelectionView spec; live: typed https://github.com/aimparency/v7.git in the running app -> Cloning… -> opened 790 ideas / 34 phases with read-only badge, .git 1.4 MB; pnpm check 25/25.
